results.reply:
Thanks, I've got the starting point: you hold a Chinese passport; you plan to apply from Hong Kong; you're planning a holiday in the UK; you're paying for the trip yourself.

No problem—I'll leave the dates open for now. I will not keep asking you for the dates while we prepare. Add and cross-check the intended itinerary before submitting the form.

You can start by asking HR for a letter on company headed paper with your role, salary and how long you have worked there. It helps explain your employment and income; check that these details match what you put in the application.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

When you apply, use the GOV.UK checker to confirm whether you need a visa or an ETA. If you need a Standard Visitor visa, the official application page's Apply now link lets you start and save the form. We can prepare the information first; you will submit it on the official website.

Official visa / ETA checker:
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/check-uk-visa
Official Standard Visitor application page (select Apply now):
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa
